question: The volume of a cube increases at $54$ cm$^3$/s. Find the rate at which its total surface area increases when its edge is $3$ cm.
explanation: Volume relationLet the edge of the cube be $x$ cm. Then $V=x^3$. Differentiating,$$\frac{dV}{dt}=3x^2\frac{dx}{dt}$$Rate of change of the edgeAt $x=3$ and $\frac{dV}{dt}=54$,$$54=3(3)^2\frac{dx}{dt}$$$$\frac{dx}{dt}=2\text{ cm/s}$$Surface-area relationThe total surface area is $S=6x^2$. Therefore,$$\frac{dS}{dt}=12x\frac{dx}{dt}$$Required rate$$\frac{dS}{dt}=12(3)(2)=72\text{ cm}^2/\text{s}$$Final resultThe total surface area is increasing at $72$ cm$^2$/s.
